title: Crestline Fleet Account: Measuring a Disputed Ticket Split Across Invoices
content:
On a Crestline Fleet Account a ticket is invoiced once per service category, so one visit to a store can appear as several invoices. For a dispute of an unapproved over-limit ticket, the ticket amount measured against the authorized amount depends on how the ticket was invoiced.

## Rule

- When the vehicle has two or more invoices dated the same day from the same store, the ticket was split by service category and the measured amount is the combined amount of those invoices.
- When the vehicle has only that invoice that day from that store and credit memos already stand on it, the measured amount is the invoice amount less those credit memos.
- Otherwise the measured amount is the invoice amount.

"The vehicle's invoices that day from that store" are the invoices posted to the account for the vehicle of the disputed invoice, carrying the disputed invoice's date and the disputed invoice's servicing store, whatever their service category; the disputed invoice itself is one of them. "Credit memos standing on it" are the credit memos booked against the disputed invoice.

## Decision table

| Invoices for the vehicle that day from that store | Credit memos on the disputed invoice | Measured amount |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | any | the combined amount of all those invoices |
| only the disputed invoice | one or more | the invoice amount less the total of those credit memos |
| only the disputed invoice | none | the invoice amount |

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

1. A truck's visit produced a tires invoice of 640.00 and a brakes invoice of 520.00, same date, same store; the brakes invoice is disputed. The measured amount is 640.00 plus 520.00, that is 1160.00.
2. A van's single repair invoice of 1310.00 carries a credit memo of 60.00. The measured amount is 1310.00 less 60.00, that is 1250.00.
3. A van's single invoice of 1310.00 has no credit memo. The measured amount is 1310.00.
4. A truck has a tires invoice dated the same day from a different store; that invoice is not from the same store, so if the disputed invoice is the only one from its own store, case 2 or 3 applies.
